notes: Gap entries name what Fieldia would need; covered means the page does what Flectra does, the server's part done by the app's data source and action answers (demos/shared/real/operations.ts).

size counts Flectra's view with the inherited views named: fields are the distinct field names in the form and its line subviews; conditions are invisible/readonly/required/column_invisible attributes holding an expression. built counts the Fieldia page: its own fields, its line fields apart.
Two small pages back the transfer: real-backorder-confirmation (Flectra's Create Backorder? wizard) and real-picking-sign (the Sign widget's dialog), opened by steps.
Defects found on the way, since fixed: the statusbar searched its steps once, before the record had loaded, so a filter with valueFrom found none; the grid ignored a table node's addLabel option.
